name: Throne-Cleaver

perks.name: Hungry Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage and ammo.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Shattering Blade
perks.desc: If your heavy attack consumes the last of your ammo, it deals significantly increased damage. Excludes aerial attacks.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.desc: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Energy Transfer
perks.desc: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.desc: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.desc: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.desc: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

perks.name: En Garde
perks.desc: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this sword do additional damage.

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.desc: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.desc: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.desc: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Impact. Aggressive(20) Solar Sword Heavy Ammo. "Titans are happy about this one. Crown-Splitter for damage, Throne-Cleaver for zooms. Crown-Splitter doubled with Strongholds will make for a very fun build. You will be able to have health, class ability energy, and zoomies all by blocking. Certainly a favorite for Stronghold lovers."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Impact. Aggressive(20) Solar Sword Heavy Ammo. "In PvP it’s a sword that does a lot of damage to supers but is very slow to use. Tireless Blade will give you the most kills for your ammo and Valiant Charge will help you cover distance or get into cover better."
